title: Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II - State Street Investment Management
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
State Street Investment Management’s Data, Analytics & AI Services (DAAIS) team is seeking an experienced hands-on architect, engineer for building the multi-cloud open architecture-based data platform that delivers trusted data products to the business functions. This role is an 80% IC role in doing hands-on engineering and developing POCs to support a resilient, scalable, performance optimized, secure multi-cloud data platform, and 20% of the capacity is responsible for managing and mentoring the employees, based out of Bangalore, responsible for the production maintenance & support of the legacy data platform. The successful candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in large-scale data platform architecture, distributed computing, data pipeline engineering, and modern cloud architecture and operational experience.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Investment Management, one of the largest asset managers in the world. We partner with many of the world’s largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. As pioneers in index, ETF, and ESG investing, we are always inventing new ways to invest.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the asset management industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II, you will -
  
  

* Validate target data platform architectures and design principles through hands-on engineering, technical spikes, and POCs for a unified, cloud-native Lakehouse.
* Partner with architects to translate reference architectures and data strategies into working prototypes, measurable validation criteria, and production-ready implementation patterns.
* Optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Python/Scala, SQL, Spark, and modern orchestration frameworks.
* Engineer high-performance Iceberg-based data models and tables, including partitioning, compaction, schema evolution, metadata management, and multi-engine interoperability.
* Establish data engineering standards for data quality, lineage, observability, reliability, versioning, and backward-compatible data product contracts.
* Optimize platform, pipeline, and query performance through workload testing, partitioning and clustering, caching, concurrency management, and cost-aware lifecycle practices.
* Lead capabilities from POC to production by defining non-functional requirements, resolving engineering risks, integrating with platform services, and enabling operational support and SLA readiness.
* Engineer AI-ready data products with trusted, well-governed, semantically enriched data, incorporating context engineering, ontologies, embeddings, vector indexing, and RAG patterns.
* Build and productionize data services for Agentic and AI workloads, including MCP-enabled access, interoperable APIs, LLM gateways, multi-model routing, caching, observability, security, and cost optimization.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to the L2/L3 support teams for legacy platform to ensure SLA adherence, escalation discipline, and timely closure of production issues impacting business, clients, or regulators.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, with 15+ years of technology experience, preferably in financial services.
* Expert-level hands-on programming in Python and SQL, with Java or Scala as a plus, and proven ability to design, debug, test, and optimize distributed data-processing solutions.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark for batch and streaming workloads, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and cost optimization.
* Proven experience building and operating enterprise Lakehouse and data platforms using Snowflake and Databricks, supporting high-concurrency analytical, near-real-time, and AI-ready workloads.
* Strong cloud engineering experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including cloud-native data services, security, networking, infrastructure automation, portability, and cost management.
* Working expertise with open data architectures and metadata ecosystems, including Apache Iceberg, schema evolution, table optimization, catalog federation, zero-copy sharing, data virtualization, and multi-engine access.
* Extensive experience productionizing data capabilities through DevOps and CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data quality, incident management, and operational support for mission-critical platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with both structured and unstructured data management tools and associated patterns
* Familiarity with modern governance frameworks (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation).
* Expertise in AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot or Claude Code Assistant.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Open role

Full Stack Engineer

Own the backend and the first AI agents on a live consumer app, from the Node API to the React Native screen.

DawerOne · Hybrid, Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month · Contract-to-hire, full-time, 6 months · 4+ years

Apply by email

**About the job**

You will join our product engineering team on a live consumer app for a North American client. The stack is Node and PostgreSQL on the backend, React Native on mobile, a managed cloud platform for deployments, payments, the web tooling around it, and the AI agents and LLM-powered features now coming into the product. Our clients are in North America and our engineering team is in Gurugram.

**You are the backend and agents owner on the team.**
You own delivery of your workstreams end to end, API through to the screen, and ship to production. The first agents on the roadmap are yours to build. A DawerOne senior lead holds architecture, priorities, and the critical engineering decisions, including mobile architecture. A second developer works alongside you on the React Native surface, a test automation engineer covers regression, payments, and notifications, and the client's product owner and QA lead are part of the day-to-day team.

About half your time goes to a second product in the same client portfolio: a Python and Flask backend on AWS with an AI layer, under the same senior lead. You do not need deep Flask or AWS expertise, but you need to be comfortable reading and changing that codebase from the start.

This is a
**contract-to-hire**
role: a
**full-time, six-month contract**
with DawerOne, converting to a permanent role on mutual fit. For a strong candidate with clear long-term alignment, we are open to full time from day one. It is
**hybrid**
: you work from home most of the month and from our
**Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month**
. Indore and Gurugram are preferred, but we will consider strong candidates elsewhere in India within travelling distance of either office. Compensation is benchmarked to seniority and we share a number in the first conversation. The top of our range goes to someone who has shipped a production agent and can show it.

**Responsibilities**

**First 30 days**

* **Ship a first feature end to end**
  , API through to the screen, within the first sprint.
* **Get the automated iOS and Android build and release pipeline working.**
* **Fix the highest-impact production issues:**
  payments, media handling, and performance across the API and database.
* **Scope the first agent**
  with the senior lead and the product owner: knowledge base, guardrails, cost model, and how it is evaluated.

**Backend and payments**

* **Build and maintain the Node and PostgreSQL backend and APIs**
  , including schema design and migrations.
* **Own the payment flows:**
  checkout, fees, onboarding, and payouts.
* **Integrate third-party services:**
  push notifications, media storage, and partner APIs.
* **Build web tooling where the product needs it:**
  admin portals and operational dashboards.

**AI agents**

* **Build and deploy AI agents and LLM-powered features:**
  agentic workflows against the backend, media analysis, and assisted content flows, using LLM APIs, tool use, and MCP.
* **Run them properly in production:**
  hosting, monitoring, cost control, and evals that tell you whether the agent is actually good.

**Features and mobile**

* **Deliver new features end to end:**
  scoping with the product owner, API design with the senior lead, the mobile build, and the release.
* **Ship React Native features and bug fixes**
  alongside the mobile developer, to patterns set by the senior lead.

**Builds, infrastructure, and operations**

* **Own builds, release management, and production deployments**
  on managed platforms such as Railway, Render, or AWS, with CI/CD for mobile and services.
* **Run the operations:**
  environments and secrets, monitoring, alerting and logging, backups and restore, and infrastructure cost, with infrastructure as code where it pays for itself.
* **Debug production issues**
  across backend, database, deployments, payments, and mobile.
* **Do performance work with measurements before and after.**

**Quality and delivery**

* **Support QA**
  with the automation engineer and the client's QA lead: regression, release validation, and bug fixing.
* **Keep Jira current:**
  blockers surfaced early, status up to date, and clear written updates.
* **Build with AI coding agents as a matter of course.**
  That is how we work.

**Minimum qualifications**

**What matters most**

For us, these matter most.

* You have
  **built and deployed at least one LLM-powered feature or agent to production:**
  prompt and tool design, structured outputs, handling failures, hosting and monitoring, controlling cost, and measuring quality. You can talk honestly about what did not work.
* **Daily, fluent use of AI coding agents**
  such as Claude Code, MCP servers, or similar. This is a hard requirement. You are productive with them from day one, with no ramp-up period.
* You can
  **debug a production issue independently across layers**
  before escalating.

**Experience**

* **4 to 6 years**
  building software, with strong backend experience:
  **Node**
  with Express or NestJS,
  **REST API design**
  , and
  **PostgreSQL**
  schema design and migrations.
* **Working Python**
  and comfort reading and changing a
  **Flask**
  codebase, plus basic
  **AWS**
  familiarity: EC2 or ECS, RDS, S3, and IAM. Deep Flask or AWS expertise is not required.
* **Production React Native experience:**
  shipped features and fixed bugs in a live app on iOS and Android, and able to work to an architecture someone else has set.
* **Hands-on with builds, CI/CD, and deployments:**
  GitHub Actions or similar for services, and you have owned environments, secrets, monitoring and alerting, and backups for a production service. Fastlane or EAS for mobile is a plus.

**Ways of working**

* You
  **take ownership of outcomes**
  , ask the right questions early, and keep delivery moving without follow-up.
* **Clear written English and Jira discipline.**
  You work directly with a North American product owner and QA lead.
* Able to work
  **roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST consistently**
  , Monday to Friday, and flexible if the window needs to move. This is a shift, not an occasional late call.
* Able to be in the
  **Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month**
  .

**Preferred qualifications**

* Deeper AWS operations, Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool, Docker in production, or Flask at scale.
* Stripe or another payment provider in production.
* Consumer commerce or payments-heavy products.
* Store releases, deep links, and push providers such as OneSignal or Firebase.
* Image or media processing flows.
* Experience working in an inherited codebase while still shipping features.

**Engagement details**

* **Engagement:**
  contract-to-hire. A six-month, full-time contract with DawerOne, converting to a permanent role on mutual fit. For a strong candidate with clear long-term alignment, we are open to full time from day one.
* **Time commitment:**
  full time, split roughly half and half between the primary consumer app (Node, PostgreSQL, React Native) and backend work on a second product in the same client portfolio (Python, Flask, AWS).
* **Exclusivity:**
  this is a full-time, exclusive engagement. You cannot hold another job or contract alongside it.
* **Location:**
  hybrid, with 2–4 days a month in our Indore or Gurugram office. Indore and Gurugram preferred; strong candidates elsewhere in India are considered if they are within travelling distance of either office and can travel for office days.
* **Working hours:**
  roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST, Monday to Friday, for daily overlap with the client's North American morning. The window may shift if the engagement demands it.
* **Start:**
  immediate joiners preferred. We do not buy out notice periods.
* **Reports to:**
  the DawerOne senior lead on the engagement.
* **Process:**
  a 30-minute screen with the hiring manager, a technical deep dive of 60 minutes or more, a 60-minute live assessment spanning a Node API, the React Native screen in front of it, and a small agentic workflow using your own AI tooling, and a 30-minute final conversation. The technical and live rounds may be combined. You hear back within two working days of applying, and we make an offer within a week of the live assessment for the right candidate.

**Who should apply**

Someone who has
**shipped a backend, a mobile feature, and an agent on products that mattered**
, and wants to own all three on one team with a senior lead who engages with the hard decisions rather than handing over a ticket list.

If you have not yet put an LLM-powered feature in front of real users, or you want to write application code and hand the deployments to someone else, this is probably not the right role yet.

**Apply**

Email us your resume. It is required. The button opens a ready-to-send email; attach your resume before sending. In the same email, answer all 6 questions below. Every answer is required; applications with unanswered questions are not accepted.

1. Which React Native apps have you built and shipped? Store links if possible.
2. Which backend technologies and databases have you worked with in production? Node is primary here; tell us how comfortable you are in Python and Flask as well.
3. Describe an LLM-powered feature or agent you built and deployed to production: what it did, how you handled failures, what it cost to run, and how you measured whether it was good.
4. How do you use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP servers or similar) in your daily work? Be specific.
5. Have you worked with Stripe or another payment provider? Which flows?
6. Working hours for this role are roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST. Can you keep those hours consistently, and are you available full time for a 6-month contract?
